title: JetBrains product-specific system caches, indexes, and logs
description: Deep product-level JetBrains coverage under ~/Library/Caches, ~/Library/Logs, and carefully scoped Application Support system residuals. Products: IntelliJ IDEA (Ultimate/Community), WebStorm, PyCharm (Pro/CE), GoLand, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, PhpStorm, DataGrip, AppCode, Android Studio residual, Fleet, Toolbox caches, MPS. Prefer caches + logs + index. LocalHistory is report-only / medium careful. Never wipe config, options, keymaps, or installed plugins trees as default.
notes: Deepens beyond coarse $HOME/Library/Caches/JetBrains and $HOME/Library/Logs/JetBrains roots in dev.yaml / dev-extended / batch-03 / batch-08. Modern JetBrains layout (post ~2019): idea.system.path = ~/Library/Caches/JetBrains/<product><version>; idea.log.path = ~/Library/Logs/JetBrains/<product><version>; idea.config.path and idea.plugins.path = ~/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/<product><version> (config/plugins NEVER default clean). Host-verified on this machine: Rider/DataGrip/RustRover/Toolbox under Caches and Logs; system subdirs include caches, index, tmp, LocalHistory, jcef_cache, plugins (download meta under system), fileHistory. Toolbox download cache observed multi-GB under Caches/JetBrains/Toolbox/download. Legacy pre-JetBrains-parent product cache roots and Application Support */system|caches|localHistory residuals included for old installs.
safety_notes: Never default-delete entire ~/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/<product>* (config: options, keymaps, codestyles, colors, scratches, settingsSync).
Never default-delete Application Support .../plugins (user-installed plugins). System-dir plugin download caches under Caches/.../plugins are regenerable and OK.
LocalHistory and fileHistory: medium, report-only preferred; wiping loses IDE local edit history across projects for that IDE version.
Do not wipe Toolbox apps install trees, accounts.json, state.json, channels, or scripts; only download/temp/logs/recovery caches.
Android Studio: prefer versioned caches/logs/system; leave Google/AndroidStudio*/options and whole config roots.
Fleet: clear Caches/JetBrains/Fleet* and logs only; leave Application Support Fleet config.
Prefer IDE Help | Invalidate Caches / Delete Leftover IDE Directories / Toolbox Clear download cache when user wants official cleanup.
SharedIndexes and global-model-cache are regenerable but large re-downloads; min_age recommended.
Do not touch project .idea/ under source trees; this batch is home Library only.
sources: JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA docs: Directories used by the IDE (config / system / plugins / logs paths on macOS)
JetBrains Rider docs: same directory layout with RiderYYYY.N product code
intellij-support HC article 206544519: macOS Application Support vs Caches vs Logs
Toolbox FAQ / support: Clear download cache; macOS logs ~/Library/Logs/JetBrains/Toolbox
Host verification: ~/Library/Caches/JetBrains/{Rider*,DataGrip*,RustRover*,Toolbox}, LocalHistory, index, caches, jcef_cache; Toolbox download multi-GB; Logs/JetBrains product dirs
